statement: The function returns a result r and r (as an integer) equals the maximum length of a valid subsequence of nums. Here a sequence sub of length k is a subsequence of nums iff there exist indices i_0 < i_1 < ... < i_{k-1} such that 0 <= i_j < len(nums) and sub[j] = nums[i_j] for every 0 <= j < k. Such a sub is valid iff there exists b in {0,1} such that for every 0 <= j < k-1, (sub[j] + sub[j+1]) mod 2 = b. The maximum is over all k >= 0 for which a valid subsequence of length k exists.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 200000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000000.

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, overflow, or access an out-of-bounds index.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 200000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= len(nums).
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 200000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= 2.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 200000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= max(O, E), where O = #{i | 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] is odd} and E = #{i | 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] is even}.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 200000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= R, where R = 1 + #{i | 0 <= i < len(nums)-1 and (nums[i] mod 2) != (nums[i+1] mod 2)}. Equivalently, R is the number of maximal non-empty contiguous blocks of nums all of whose entries have the same parity.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 200000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = len(nums).
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 200000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000000. All entries of nums have the same parity (either every nums[i] is odd or every nums[i] is even).

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 2.

Whenever the function returns a result r, there exist indices i_0 < i_1 < ... < i_{r-1} with 0 <= i_j < len(nums) such that the sequence (nums[i_0], nums[i_1], ..., nums[i_{r-1}]) is valid, i.e. there exists b in {0,1} with (nums[i_j] + nums[i_{j+1}]) mod 2 = b for every 0 <= j < r-1.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 200000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every k >= 0 and every indices i_0 < i_1 < ... < i_{k-1} with 0 <= i_j < len(nums), if there exists b in {0,1} such that (nums[i_j] + nums[i_{j+1}]) mod 2 = b for every 0 <= j < k-1, then k <= r.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 200000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000000.

statement: Whenever maximum_length(nums) returns a result r and maximum_length(nums') returns a result r', one has r = r'.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 200000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000000. Let nums' be any integer array with len(nums') = len(nums), 2 <= len(nums') <= 200000, for every i, 1 <= nums'[i] <= 10000000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums'[i] mod 2 = nums[i] mod 2.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= max(max(O, E), R), where O = #{i | 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] is odd}, E = #{i | 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] is even}, and R = 1 + #{i | 0 <= i < len(nums)-1 and (nums[i] mod 2) != (nums[i+1] mod 2)}.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 200000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = len(nums) if and only if there exists b in {0,1} such that for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums)-1, (nums[i] + nums[i+1]) mod 2 = b.
preconditions: 2 <= len(nums) <= 200000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000000.
